mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits CYP2D6 and may increase primaquine levels; both drugs have potential hematologic effects and primaquine carries risk of hemolytic anemia in G6PD deficiency.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia signs (hemoglobinuria, jaundice, dark urine) and consider G6PD screening; assess for serotonin syndrome given venlafaxine's SNRI activity.
